ledger: 00:00-00:09: Subject and mirror reflection visible simultaneously.
00:00-00:01: Subject holds a dark object (comb), performs shaving motion.
00:02-00:03: Subject moves comb to hair; reflection matches motion.
00:04-00:09: Subject returns dark object to face for shaving motion.

findings.description: The real subject is holding a dark grey/black comb while performing a shaving motion, but the reflection shows him holding a bright white object (resembling a disposable razor).

After the reflection correctly shows a dark comb during the hair-combing sequence (00:02-00:03), the object in the reflection's hand changes back into a bright white razor-like object for the second shaving sequence, while the real subject continuously holds the dark comb.
